scenario_description:
Objective: Have a compliant seat available for each of the sixteen confirmed guests when the February 8 story-circle opening begins.
Emerging Need: A paid room booking outgrows its twelve included chairs once the final headcount arrives.
Decision Context: Stored setup notes supply a free cancellable four-chair loan route and its Tuesday cutoff. Missing that route does not eliminate later alternatives, which should still be explored before Sunday.
Consequence: The last event is the actual opening with four guests left standing; preparation before that opening is now late, even though later seating improvements may still help.

parameter.subject: Hawthorne House parlor availability for February 8
parameter.body: The upstairs parlor is available Sunday, February 8, 6:00-9:00 p.m. for an informal reading or story gathering. The standard setup includes twelve house chairs around the rug, with renter-supplied rubber-foot seating allowed if arranged independently.

parameter.content: I checked with a few circle regulars about the February 8 parlor idea. We have seven clear yeses and two maybes so far, so it still sounds like a small evening if the room works out.

parameter.description: Room booking deposit for the February 8 Riverside story-circle parlor night.

parameter.title: Riverside story-circle parlor night
parameter.description: Confirmed Hawthorne House parlor gathering; standard room setup lists twelve house chairs.

parameter.content: Headcount changed for Sunday: I now count sixteen confirmed for the parlor night. I also checked the easy option I mentioned, and nobody nearby has spare folding chairs to lend this week.

parameter.subject: Story-circle opening started with twelve chairs
parameter.body: The opening story began at 18:30 with all sixteen confirmed guests here. Only the twelve house chairs were supplied and four guests are standing through the opening. No loan chairs arrived. The venue has no additional chairs to release tonight. Later independent arrangements could still improve the rest of the evening.
